title: Jack: charged twice, wants a person

steps.text: Hello, thanks for calling {{bank_name}}. You're speaking with the bank's AI specialist, and this call is recorded. Could I start with your full name, please?
Jack Robinson. Coastline Hardware has charged me twice. Two hundred and forty-nine dollars, twice, for the one drill.

steps.summary: Caller says Coastline Hardware charged him $249 twice.

steps.text: That's not on, let's have a look. First, what's your date of birth?

Thanks {{submit_identity_answers.first_name|Jack}}. To look at your transactions I need one more quick security question. {{start_identity_check.questions.0.prompt|Roughly how much was your last pay into your account?}}
Forty-one hundred. Can we get on with it?
Thanks, that's confirmed. Thank you for that. I'll need to place you on hold for a moment while I check the system. I'll be right back with you.
Thanks for holding. I can see both charges from Coastline Hardware, two hundred and forty-nine dollars each. One has gone through and the other is still pending.
I can raise a dispute for the duplicate right now, so the extra charge is reversed. Would you like me to do that?
No. I've been through this before and it took weeks. I want to talk to a real person, now.

steps.summary: Jack is frustrated about a duplicate $249 charge from Coastline Hardware (one posted, one pending) and has asked for a person.

steps.text: Of course, Jack. Thanks, just a moment while I put that through in the system.

args.reason: Charged twice by Coastline Hardware ($249 posted and $249 pending). Frustrated and wants to speak with a person.

steps.text: {{request_human.specialist_name|A specialist}} from our team will join us in about {{request_human.expected_wait_minutes|2}} minutes, and they'll have everything we've covered. Your reference is {{request_human.case_number|coming through by text}}.
Thanks for bearing with me. I've noted both charges and the times, so you won't have to repeat yourself.

steps.ai_if_timeout: I'm sorry, Jack, our specialist is still tied up. Your callback case {{request_human.case_number|is open}} has everything noted, and {{request_human.specialist_name|a specialist}} will ring you back on this number as soon as they're free.

steps.text: Thanks for your patience, Jack. Take care.
